name: Daydreamer
note: Tucked off the street, so it never feels crowded. Big enough for a group to study, with a seasonal drink menu. Open 10 to 2 daily.

name: Sunroof
note: Small and quiet downtown, plus the original Tracy St location that hosts art markets. Rotating seasonal menu.

name: 1000 Faces
note: The roaster with the best reputation in town. Bright, plant-filled, and sustainability-focused. Weekdays 7 to 6.

name: Foxtail
note: Newer downtown spot that fills up with students. Good wifi and a well-loved matcha, but pricier and parking is tight.

name: Independent Baking Co
note: Really a bakery that serves great coffee. Worth it for the sourdough and croissants. Patio seating, closed Mondays.

name: The Rook & Pawn
note: A board game cafe more than a coffee shop. $7 per person to play. Better for a group hang than a study session.

name: Dutch Bros Coffee
note: Drive-thru chain with sweet drinks and fast service. Open 5 a.m. to 10 p.m.

name: 7 Brew Coffee
note: Drive-thru with huge sizes and lots of flavor options. Open 5:30 a.m. to 10 or 11.

name: Caribou Coffee
note: A chain, but this location has a well-liked crew. Breakfast food, drive-thru, open 6 to 6 daily.
